description: Save the current topology (devices, links, IOS commands, host IP configurations) to a JSON file that load_topology can read back. Use an absolute path: relative paths resolve against $MCP_TRACER_DIR if set, else the server's working directory (now /tmp/churn-4bp5gvaz), which MCP clients often set arbitrarily. "~" is the user's home directory. Missing folders are created. Refuses to replace an existing file unless overwrite: true. The result shows the absolute path written.

overwrite.description: true = replace the file if it already exists.

path.description: File to write, e.g. C:\labs\vlans.json or /home/me/labs/vlans.json. Only .json file names are accepted; .json is added when the file name has no extension. Absolute path recommended.

name: save_topology
title: Save topology
